name: before-your-first-meeting
transcript:
Before your first meeting

In person

  • Check the address, meeting room, entrance, and any parking instructions.
  • Allow a few extra minutes to find the room. Ask the group contact about accessibility or language needs beforehand.
  • When you arrive, you can say, “This is my first meeting. Am I in the right place?”

Online

  • Check the time zone, meeting link, passcode, and whether you need an app.
  • Choose somewhere you can listen privately, and try your sound beforehand. Headphones can help protect others’ privacy.
  • Read the group’s joining instructions and ask about camera use, muting, or how to indicate you would like to speak.

For either type

You can begin by listening. There is no need to prepare a speech or explain your whole situation. If something is unclear, ask the group contact or a member before or after the meeting.

For a hybrid meeting, follow the preparation that matches how you’ll attend. For a telephone meeting, save the dial-in number and access code, check the time zone, and find a private place to listen.
